recommendation.label: proposed from repeated measurements
recommendation.statement: Retain P768 and P896 as practical candidates for this M512/H4096/I14336 HX370 default-mode workload. Final order-reversed medians differ only0.053 and0.020ms, far less than their sample p10-p90 spans; this is not a statistical equivalence test.
recommendation.single_default_if_required: P768 is a reasonable conservative preset with a smaller NPU share; choose P896 only as an equally viable measured preset, not a proven unique optimum. Reprofile on the actual model schedule.
limits: Results are synthetic complete FFN, not model prefill/TTFT.
The mode remains default, not performance.

GPU baseline variation can reverse tiny speedup rankings even when absolute-latency rankings agree.
